flow.name: 03 · Daily morning reminder (TimeOfDay)
flow.notes: Fires at 08:30 on weekdays (MON–FRI). Tests TimeOfDay trigger + daysOfWeek filter + the trigger.* magic-text bindings (hour, minute, dayOfWeek). Once enabled, you don't need to do anything else — wait for the next weekday morning to confirm it fires. Test now: edit the trigger to a time 2 minutes in the future and watch.

actions.title: Good morning!
actions.text: It's {trigger.hour}:{trigger.minute} on {trigger.dayOfWeek}. Time to start the day.
actions.label: Daily reminder
